scripts.dev: npm run build -w @auralis/playlist-core && npm run build -w @auralis/api && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @auralis/api" "npm run dev -w @auralis/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @auralis/playlist-core && npm run build -w @auralis/api && npm run build -w @auralis/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @auralis/playlist-core && npm run build -w @auralis/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @auralis/playlist-core && npm run build -w @auralis/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @auralis/playlist-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json
